scope: Independent SOURCE safety review: historical startup quiescence versus current Stop, generation read/commit interleavings, model task cancellation/join and supervisor finalization. Not installed/runtime acceptance.

checks.evidence: Initial real InstanceService.quiesce runs before LocalControl startup and before binding close_model_test. NativeTaskOwner construction creates no task. Both historical STOPPED and virgin startup remain open at control entry and across two idle heartbeat ticks; no old latch is reset.

New OPEN and SHUTDOWN each advance generation. SHUTDOWN clears quiescence. The skip is restricted to the captured startup generation. Reviewer test exercises Stop before OPEN and Stop after a changed-generation read; the real quiesce uses current locked state and joins a task with an asynchronous cancellation finalizer before runtime drain or the simulated quiescence UPDATE.

Forced read/commit interleaving returns the old startup snapshot after real service OPEN/SHUTDOWN methods have run against simulated records. That heartbeat skips quiesce but writes no receipt; shutdown remains unquiesced. The next heartbeat observes the new generation and closes/joins before drain. A stale read delays observation by a tick, not admission fencing. Unchanged native_preparation_commit and runtime_authority reject shutdown and stale generation under instance/lease locks.

Reviewer false-drain case raises SHUTDOWN_INCOMPLETE without any quiescence UPDATE, then closes runtime/releases/disposes through the unchanged finalizer. Existing tests cover LocalControl startup failure and early exit with actual NativeTaskOwner close, and loop failures/cancellation at readiness, heartbeat, quiesce, runtime status and renewal. No new swallowing of model-task join or outer cancellation was introduced.

Existing operation test now proves the closed owner refuses TASK_UNAVAILABLE. A distinct new owner/epoch reads the retained operation as UNKNOWN without increasing synthetic send/read count. No budget, grant, runtime authority, effect guard or retry code changed.
